# What could your online business sell for?

> Free online business valuation calculator. Enter revenue and SDE to get a sale price range for a SaaS, ecommerce, content or agency business, adjusted for growth, churn, concentration and owner hours. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
